CASE WHEN region IS NULL OR TRIM(region) = '' THEN '未知区域' WHEN region LIKE '%东城%' THEN '东城区' WHEN region LIKE '%西城%' THEN '西城区' WHEN region LIKE '%朝阳%' THEN '朝阳区' WHEN region LIKE '%丰台%' THEN '丰台区' WHEN region LIKE '%石景山%' THEN '石景山区' WHEN region LIKE '%海淀%' THEN '海淀区' WHEN region LIKE '%门头沟%' THEN '门头沟区' WHEN region LIKE '%房山%' THEN '房山区' WHEN region LIKE '%通州%' THEN '通州区' WHEN region LIKE '%顺义%' THEN '顺义区' WHEN region LIKE '%昌平%' THEN '昌平区' WHEN region LIKE '%大兴%' THEN '大兴区' WHEN region LIKE '%怀柔%' THEN '怀柔区' WHEN region LIKE '%平谷%' THEN '平谷区' WHEN region LIKE '%密云%' THEN '密云区' WHEN region LIKE '%延庆%' THEN '延庆区' ELSE region END

CASE WHEN rent IS NULL THEN '未知租金' WHEN rent < 3000 THEN '3000以下' WHEN rent >= 3000 AND rent < 5000 THEN '3000-5000' WHEN rent >= 5000 AND rent < 8000 THEN '5000-8000' WHEN rent >= 8000 AND rent < 12000 THEN '8000-12000' ELSE '12000以上' END
CASE WHEN rent IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN rent < 3000 THEN 1 WHEN rent >= 3000 AND rent < 5000 THEN 2 WHEN rent >= 5000 AND rent < 8000 THEN 3 WHEN rent >= 8000 AND rent < 12000 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

CASE WHEN area IS NULL THEN '未知面积' WHEN area < 30 THEN '30㎡以下' WHEN area >= 30 AND area < 50 THEN '30-50㎡' WHEN area >= 50 AND area < 70 THEN '50-70㎡' WHEN area >= 70 AND area < 100 THEN '70-100㎡' ELSE '100㎡以上' END
CASE WHEN area IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN area < 30 THEN 1 WHEN area >= 30 AND area < 50 THEN 2 WHEN area >= 50 AND area < 70 THEN 3 WHEN area >= 70 AND area < 100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
CASE WHEN bedroom IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN bedroom <= 0 THEN '0室' WHEN bedroom = 1 THEN '1室' WHEN bedroom = 2 THEN '2室' WHEN bedroom = 3 THEN '3室' WHEN bedroom = 4 THEN '4室' ELSE '5室及以上' END
CASE WHEN bedroom IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN bedroom <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN bedroom = 1 THEN 1 WHEN bedroom = 2 THEN 2 WHEN bedroom = 3 THEN 3 WHEN bedroom = 4 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

CASE WHEN subway IS NULL OR TRIM(subway) = '' THEN '未知' WHEN subway LIKE '%否%' OR subway LIKE '%无%' OR subway LIKE '%远%' THEN '非近地铁' WHEN subway LIKE '%是%' OR subway LIKE '%有%' OR subway LIKE '%近%' THEN '近地铁' ELSE subway END

CASE WHEN heating IS NULL OR TRIM(heating) = '' THEN '未知' WHEN heating LIKE '%集中%' THEN '集中供暖' WHEN heating LIKE '%自%' OR heating LIKE '%壁挂%' OR heating LIKE '%独立%' THEN '自采暖' WHEN heating LIKE '%否%' OR heating LIKE '%无%' THEN '无供暖' ELSE heating END

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN region IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(region) != '' THEN region END) AS regionCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(MIN(rent), 2) AS minRent, ROUND(MAX(rent), 2) AS maxRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent, ROUND(AVG(bedroom), 2) AS avgBedroom, SUM(CASE WHEN subway IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(subway) != '' AND subway NOT LIKE '%否%' AND subway NOT LIKE '%无%' AND subway NOT LIKE '%远%' AND (subway LIKE '%是%' OR subway LIKE '%有%' OR subway LIKE '%近%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subwayCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN subway IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(subway) != '' AND subway NOT LIKE '%否%' AND subway NOT LIKE '%无%' AND subway NOT LIKE '%远%' AND (subway LIKE '%是%' OR subway LIKE '%有%' OR subway LIKE '%近%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS subwayRate, SUM(CASE WHEN heating IS NOT NULL AND heating LIKE '%集中%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS centralizedHeatingCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN heating IS NOT NULL AND heating LIKE '%集中%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS centralizedHeatingRate FROM

SELECT regionName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(MIN(rent), 2) AS minRent, ROUND(MAX(rent), 2) AS maxRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent, ROUND(AVG(bedroom), 2) AS avgBedroom, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN subway IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(subway) != '' AND subway NOT LIKE '%否%' AND subway NOT LIKE '%无%' AND subway NOT LIKE '%远%' AND (subway LIKE '%是%' OR subway LIKE '%有%' OR subway LIKE '%近%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS subwayRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN heating IS NOT NULL AND heating LIKE '%集中%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS centralizedHeatingRate FROM ( SELECT AS regionName, rent, area, bedroom, subway, heating FROM
) t GROUP BY regionName ORDER BY totalCount DESC, avgRent DESC

SELECT rentSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM ( SELECT AS rentSegment, AS orderNo, rent, area FROM
) t GROUP BY rentSegment, orderNo ORDER BY orderNo ASC

SELECT areaSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM ( SELECT AS areaSegment, AS orderNo, rent, area FROM
) t GROUP BY areaSegment, orderNo ORDER BY orderNo ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN room IS NULL OR TRIM(room) = '' THEN '未知房型' ELSE room END AS name, COUNT(1) AS value, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM
GROUP BY CASE WHEN room IS NULL OR TRIM(room) = '' THEN '未知房型' ELSE room END ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT bedroomSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM ( SELECT AS bedroomSegment, AS orderNo, rent, area FROM
) t GROUP BY bedroomSegment, orderNo ORDER BY orderNo ASC

SELECT subwayFlag, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM ( SELECT AS subwayFlag, rent, area FROM
) t GROUP BY subwayFlag ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN floor_grp IS NULL OR TRIM(floor_grp) = '' THEN '未知楼层' ELSE floor_grp END AS floorGrp, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM
GROUP BY CASE WHEN floor_grp IS NULL OR TRIM(floor_grp) = '' THEN '未知楼层' ELSE floor_grp END ORDER BY totalCount DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT heatingFlag, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(area), 2) AS avgArea, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM ( SELECT AS heatingFlag, rent, area FROM
) t GROUP BY heatingFlag ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT regionName, bedroomSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(AVG(rent), 2) AS avgRent, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 THEN rent / area END), 2) AS avgUnitRent FROM ( SELECT AS regionName, AS bedroomSegment, AS bedroomOrder, rent, area FROM
) t GROUP BY regionName, bedroomSegment, bedroomOrder ORDER BY regionName ASC, bedroomOrder ASC

) t WHERE rent IS NOT NULL AND area IS NOT NULL AND area > 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 400
